newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - San Carlos SD, Calif..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - San Carlos SD, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that sealed or facsimile bids will be received by The Stiepel Group, Inc., the Financial Advisor, acting on behalf of the San Carlos School District (the "District") and the County of San Mateo (the "County"), for the purchase of $2,000,000* principal amount of San Carlos School District, County of San Mateo, California 1997 Tax and Revenue Anticipation Notes at the hour of 10:30 A.M., Pacific Daylight Time, on Wednesday,
at the office of The Stiepel Group, Inc., 22761 Pacific Coast Highway, Suite 1025, Malibu, California 90265,

facsimile no. (310) 456-9340. In the event that no bid is awarded, the County will receive bids each successive Wednesday at the same time and location until such time as a bid is awarded or the County determines to withdraw sale of the Notes. An Official Statement and an Official Notice of Sale relating to the Notes will be furnished upon request to the Financial Advisor at (310) 456-9335.
